property_summary: For any non-zero, non-self contract_address and non-empty equal-length tos and vs arrays, C.transfer always returns true only after performing all external transferFrom calls (so if any callee reverts the whole call reverts); the mutant that skips the loop can return true even when an actual callee would have reverted, breaking the property that a failing callee makes transfer revert.
change_summary: Change the loop to always skip body by iterating zero times, causing transfer to return true without performing any calls (changes observable return when calls would have succeeded/failured impact), here by setting loop bound to 0.
